schema.description: `task_skip` wire command.

oneOf.description:
Оператор ОТКАЗАЛСЯ: «эту паллету я уже поставил, дай другую».

Задача уходит в пул с отметкой и на время остывания не выдаётся НИКОМУ — иначе следующий запрос вернул бы её ему же, и он оказался бы в цикле.

Оператор СДАЛ задачу: перерыв, конец смены.

Он ни от чего не отказывался, поэтому ни причины, ни отметки: строка возвращается в пул чистой и доступна любому немедленно. Прятать её на десять минут значило бы наказывать склад за чужой обед — и именно так это и работало, пока возврат был один на оба случая.

work_area_id.description: Участок, на который настроен терминал (шаг 6): из него берётся `allow_task_release`. Необязателен — прежний вызов законен и значит «вне объявленного участка», ровно как у `ClaimTask`.

`None` — взвесить было нечем (`PhysicalMetric::Unknown`): ни у базовой строки упаковки, ни у карточки товара веса нет. Такая задача проходит любой предел грузоподъёмности — проверка, которой нечего сравнивать, не имеет права отказывать (wms-app 341, спека физических измерений §9.2). Ноль больше не значит «неизвестно»: он сравнивается как число.

OrderLineStatus.description:
The line's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.2). A line with no reservations is `NotAllocated` — including after an unallocate — so the status honestly answers "is there stock under this line?". Variant order matches the Postgres enum's own order, which IS the ladder.

Derived, like the header's: `wms_outbound::domain::shipment_order:: derive_line_status` recomputes it from the counters inside every mutating transaction. The `Released` rung is measured by picks handed to a task (`pick_detail.status = 'Released'`) — `wms_tasks::service::generate:: generate_tasks_for_picks` (task 7) is that writer. On a LAUNCHED order it dispatches, in the SAME transaction, every live pick of the order that does not carry a task yet — not just the ones the current `release` / `Allocate` pass reserved itself, which would forever skip a pick that a pre-launch `Allocate` (spec §3.1) had already reserved before the gate let dispatch happen. So this rung is reached routinely, not merely a future special case of the picking phase.

OrderStatus.description:
The header's status ladder (migration 285, spec 2026-08-19 §1.1): `New → Allocated → Released → Picked → Closed`, every working rung with a `Partially` form, `Cancelled` reachable until things are picked. Variant order matches the Postgres enum's own order, which IS the ladder.

Status is a DERIVED column: the truth lives in the lines' counters and the header's markers (`released_at`/`cancelled_at`/`closed_at`); `wms_outbound::domain::shipment_order::derive_order_status` recomputes it inside every mutating transaction.

schema.description:
The wire shape of "create a report", which still carries a `name`: the report wizard asks its author for one, and that author has no idea labels exist. [`ReportDefinitionBmc::create`] turns it into the report's label.

No `Fields` derive, unlike the other `ForCreate` structs in this crate: `name` is not a column, so this shape cannot be handed to sea-query at all. [`ReportDefinitionForInsert`] is what gets written.

name.description: What the author called the report. Becomes the label's `default_text` — the English source — because that is the only slot a brand-new label has. If the author typed Russian, English now holds Russian for that one report until somebody edits it; the alternative is refusing to create a report until an English name exists, which no wizard asks for.

param_values.description:
Значения для `$1, $2, …` — список ПОЗИЦИОННЫЙ: элемент N это `$N+1`.

Читается своим десериализатором, потому что до него доезжает уже НОРМАЛИЗОВАННОЕ тело: `app-server/src/web/routes_rpc.rs` схлопывает каждую пустую строку в теле запроса в `null`. Политика верная и общая — оператор, пропустивший необязательное поле, не должен создавать контейнер с пустым `code`, — но здесь она встречается с полем, где пустое значение ЗАКОННО: параметр отчёта, который человек не заполнил, это пустая строка, а не отсутствие элемента. Выбросить элемент нельзя тем более: список позиционный, и пропажа сдвинула бы все следующие `$N`.

См. [`param_values_from_wire`].

InventoryHold.description:
Represents a hold placed on inventory, supporting lot, location, or LPN-based holds.

This struct is designed for detailed tracking and auditing of inventory holds in a warehouse management system. It supports flexible hold types (lot, location, LPN), status management, and full audit trails.

# Fields - `id`: Unique identifier for the hold record. - `code`: Business code for the hold (may be used for grouping or referencing). - `lot`: Optional lot number, if the hold is placed at the lot level. - `loc`: Optional location code, if the hold is placed at the location level. - `lpn`: Optional License Plate Number, if the hold is placed on a movable unit. - `is_hold_on`: `true` if the hold is currently active, `false` if released. - `status`: The current status of the hold (custom enum). - `date_on`: Timestamp when the hold was placed. - `who_on`: User ID or actor who placed the hold. - `date_off`: Timestamp when the hold was released (if applicable). - `who_off`: User ID or actor who released the hold (if applicable). - `comments`: Optional comments or notes about the hold. - `hours_to_hold`: Optional planned duration (in hours) for the hold. - `auto_release_date`: Optional date when the hold should be automatically released. - `add_who`: User ID who created the record. - `add_when`: Timestamp when the record was created. - `mod_who`: User ID who last modified the record. - `mod_when`: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

# Serialization - Uses RFC3339 datetime format for all timestamps. - Designed for use with Serde and SQLx for seamless database and API integration.

# Example ``` let hold = InventoryHold { id: 1, code: "HOLD-2025-001".to_string(), lot: Some("LOT-123".to_string()), loc: None, lpn: None, is_hold_on: true, status: InventoryStatusHold::Active, date_on: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), who_on: 42, date_off: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), who_off: 0, comments: Some("Quality check pending".to_string()), hours_to_hold: Some(24.0), auto_release_date: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), add_who: 42, add_when: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), mod_who: 42, mod_when: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), }; ```

schema.description:
Represents a hold placed on inventory, supporting lot, location, or LPN-based holds.

This struct is designed for detailed tracking and auditing of inventory holds in a warehouse management system. It supports flexible hold types (lot, location, LPN), status management, and full audit trails.

# Fields - `id`: Unique identifier for the hold record. - `code`: Business code for the hold (may be used for grouping or referencing). - `lot`: Optional lot number, if the hold is placed at the lot level. - `loc`: Optional location code, if the hold is placed at the location level. - `lpn`: Optional License Plate Number, if the hold is placed on a movable unit. - `is_hold_on`: `true` if the hold is currently active, `false` if released. - `status`: The current status of the hold (custom enum). - `date_on`: Timestamp when the hold was placed. - `who_on`: User ID or actor who placed the hold. - `date_off`: Timestamp when the hold was released (if applicable). - `who_off`: User ID or actor who released the hold (if applicable). - `comments`: Optional comments or notes about the hold. - `hours_to_hold`: Optional planned duration (in hours) for the hold. - `auto_release_date`: Optional date when the hold should be automatically released. - `add_who`: User ID who created the record. - `add_when`: Timestamp when the record was created. - `mod_who`: User ID who last modified the record. - `mod_when`: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

# Serialization - Uses RFC3339 datetime format for all timestamps. - Designed for use with Serde and SQLx for seamless database and API integration.

# Example ``` let hold = InventoryHold { id: 1, code: "HOLD-2025-001".to_string(), lot: Some("LOT-123".to_string()), loc: None, lpn: None, is_hold_on: true, status: InventoryStatusHold::Active, date_on: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), who_on: 42, date_off: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), who_off: 0, comments: Some("Quality check pending".to_string()), hours_to_hold: Some(24.0), auto_release_date: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), add_who: 42, add_when: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), mod_who: 42, mod_when: OffsetDateTime::now_utc(), }; ```
schema.title: InventoryHold

schema.description:
The six filters, exactly as the RF screen sends them.

Every field is optional and an empty or whitespace-only string means "not filtering on this" — the screen always sends all six keys, because a missing key makes rf-go's picker silently refuse to open (design spec §3.2).

owner.description: Owner id (all digits) or a company-name fragment. One screen field, because an operator has one thing written on the paperwork.

schema.title: InquiryFilters

oneOf.description: Коробка отгрузки, созданная картонизацией. Физика берётся не из мастера типов, а из строки политики, по которой её создали (`cartonization_policy_detail_id`).

container_type.description: Display (migration 178): `container.container_type` (Pallet/Case/…) — drives the type-glyph badge on the Container column, paired with `lpn`. Native enum (sqlx::Type); serializes to its label ("Pallet"/…) so the grid renderer reads the type string.

hold_detail.description: VIRTUAL: reason + scope of the matching hold, e.g. `'Damaged · Location'`; `''` when the row is not held.

hold_status.description: VIRTUAL: `'On hold'` when an active hold matches this row's lot / loc / lpn, else `''` (empty → the grid renders no chip). Derived live, never stored.

lpn.description: Display (migration 178): `container.code` (LPN) for `container_id`; `None` for loose stock. Lets the grid filter the Container column by text and the Hard-Move drill-in show the real LPN instead of "loose stock".

qty_expected.description: Computed: Σ open-ASN remaining (`qty_expected − qty_received`) for this sku+owner.

qty_on_hold.description: Computed: `qty` when an active hold matches this row's lot / loc / lpn, else `0`.

serial_tracked.description: Whether this row's SKU is configured for end-to-end serial capture. NOT a view column — the view knows nothing about serial config. Filled in by `search_balances` after the query (`SkuSerialConfigBmc:: serial_tracked_skus`), so the RF Move screen can decide whether a PARTIAL move needs the units scanned. `#[field(skip)]` keeps it out of the sea-query projection; `#[sqlx(default)]` keeps `FromRow` from demanding a column that isn't selected — it comes back `false` and the enrichment step sets it.

methods.summary: RF stock search by any of lot / location / LPN / serial / SKU / owner. At least one filter is required; refuses rather than truncates past 200 rows.

methods.name: create_attribute_def

data_type.description:
`From<AttrDataType> for sea_query::Value` binds the label as text, and Postgres has no implicit text → `attr_data_type` cast (42804), so the value is cast in the INSERT itself — as every other enum column written through `Fields` is (`sku`, `user`, `task`, …).

Until the 2026-09-23 squash this one column was carried instead by a database-wide `CREATE CAST (text AS attr_data_type) … AS IMPLICIT` (archived migration 058). `pg_dump` does not emit casts, so the baseline dropped it and every `create` here began failing with 42804. The cast was never restored: it was a workaround for the missing attribute below, and an implicit cast would let any stray text land in the enum for the whole database.

entity_type.description: Required, and deliberately not defaulted: a caller that does not know whose row it is writing does not know enough to write it. See [`AttributeValue::entity_type`].

Which KIND of entity `entity_id` names — `'sku'`, `'location'`, …

`attribute_value` is a generic EAV table and `entity_id` alone does not identify anything: SKU ids and location ids are independent sequences, so `entity_id = 7` is both SKU 7 and location 7. This is the discriminator that tells them apart, and migration 219's composite FK onto `attribute_def (id, entity_type)` makes it impossible for it to disagree with the definition the row points at.
